audit.whatIsWrong: The entire matchup tracks a placeholder called 'Ultimate' — focus.text, the cooldown breakdown, the do's, the don'ts and the key-interaction report all say 'Zaahen Ultimate' with no ability named. The packet also flags that there is no cooldown sequencing anywhere in this matchup.
audit.why: The kit gives real numbers: Q The Darkin Glaive is 10/9/8/7/6s, an auto-attack reset that heals him and can be recast for a knockup; W is an 850-range stab that pulls you in, 14s; E Aureate Rush is a dash flagged percentHealth, 10/9.5/9/8.5/8s; R Grim Deliverance is 110/95/80s and heals him. The passive builds Determination and grants a revive when full. The thing to track in lane is Aureate Rush's 10s dash, not the ultimate.
audit.corrected: Track Aureate Rush (E) at 10s rank 1 as the engage timer; name The Darkin Glaive's reset and the Determination revive; buy Grievous Wounds against Q and R.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 2 is marked Kennen although whys[1] says he edges the trades, and Levels 4-5 are 'Skill' although whys[3] says his gap-close all-in overpowers you.
audit.why: Both rows contradict their own why text and the packet chart, which has Zaahen for level 2 and levels 4-5.

The spike shape is right and unusually well-specified for this champion: Kennen at level 3, Zaahen at 4-5, Kennen at first item and full build. Zaahen's own hidden spike is a filled Determination bar, which carries a revive.

audit.whatIsWrong: Itemization lists no anti-heal despite two healing abilities in his kit.
audit.why: The Darkin Glaive heals on cast and Grim Deliverance heals for a portion of damage dealt, so extended trades turn on Grievous Wounds timing.
audit.corrected: Anti-heal put into the mid-game trading rule.

edits.after: His level 2: The Darkin Glaive's recast knocks you up before a third mark lands, so give him nothing.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Ultimate's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: His window: Aureate Rush (E, 10s at rank 1) closes the moment your Lightning Rush is spent — poke only with E up.

notes: This matchup tracked a placeholder ability called 'Ultimate' in six separate fields — it is now Aureate Rush (E), his 10-second dash engage, which is what the reader actually has to time. Ability names came from the missing-interactions headlines (The Darkin Glaive Q, Aureate Rush E, Grim Deliverance R) because the packet's enemyAbilities block was null; I did not invent a name for his W and referred to it only as 'his W pull'.
